 ----Petitioner
 Versus

2.

Smt. Rekha Kanwar W/o Suraj Jagla, R/o 10 R 50, Vivek
 Vihar, Jodhpur.

----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Laxman Bishnoi.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Monga
Order 13/08/2024

1. Quashing of Fir No.0144/2024 dated 01.04.2024, registered at P.S. Kudi Bhagtasani, Jodhpur
City West for the alleged offences under Sections 323, 376(2)(n) & 382 Ipc, is sought herein.

2.  At the very outset, learned Public Prosecutor submits that after investigation, the allegations qua other cognizable offences originally alleged were found to be false and only offences under Sections 323 & 341 IPC have been found to be worthy of being prosecuted by filing charge-sheet.

Both the offences are since bailable, the petition is disposed of with the direction that in case, formal arrest of the petitioner is required to be caused, he shall be forthwith released on bail on furnishing a personal bond to the satisfaction of the I.O.
3.

In view of the aforesaid observations and statement of learned Public Prosecutor, learned counsel for the petitioner also [2024:RJ-JD:33573] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2339/2024] submits that he does not want to press the petition qua the offences for which charge-sheet is being filed and the petitioner shall seek his remedy, which may otherwise be available to him qua the charge-sheet to be filed.

(ARUN MONGA),J 21-Rmathur/-
